KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Praavah (प्रवाह)

Bold pours of crimson, teal, cobalt, chartreuse and cream collide across a pale ground in this energetic abstract, the fluid shapes flowing and pooling like poured colour caught mid-motion. Playful and fresh with high contrast, its busiest activity clusters through the upper and central area while the lower field opens into calmer cream. Keep a headboard or low console beneath the quieter base so the vivid pours stay in view above furniture. Lively enough for a kids' room, living room, foyer or creative office. It prints as one continuous mural scaled to your exact wall, never repeated. Premium Non-Woven, with its refined matte flat-colour clarity, keeps the crisp pooled edges sharp.
